Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, __and wherein the speaker has a resonant frequency below 200 Hz__.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone __and wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure__.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in claim 1 or 2, wherein the membrane (10) is injection moulded __and wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8)__.

Claim 4 (Original): A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), __and wherein the speaker further comprises a support structure (32,34) which defines a back volume (36), wherein the back volume is less than 0.5cm³__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, further comprising a support structure (32,34) which defines a back volume (36), wherein the back volume is less than 1cm³ __and wherein the resonant frequency is below 200 Hz__.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in claim 6, wherein the back volume (36) is less than 0.5cm³ __and wherein the resonant frequency is below 200 Hz__.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the resonant frequency is below 300 Hz __and wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure__.

Claim 9 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the resonant frequency is below 250 Hz __and wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure__.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2), __wherein the assembled speaker has a resonant frequency below 200 Hz__.

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises silicone __and wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure__.

Claim 12 (Original): A method as claimed in claim 10 or 11, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A method as claimed in claim 10 or 11, wherein the membrane (10) is formed using injection moulding __and wherein the membrane (10) is formed with a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the method further comprises providing a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane to the coil (8)__.

Claim 14 (Currently Amended): A method as claimed in any one of claims 10 to 13, wherein the membrane (10) is formed with a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the method further comprises providing a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane to the coil (8) __and assembling the speaker with a support structure (32,34) which defines a back volume (36), wherein the back volume is less than 0.5cm³__.
